text.en:
Today you say what you saw or heard.
I saw Tom leave.
I heard Anna laugh.
After saw or heard, the next word stays short.
Not leaves. Not left.

title.en: Him, her, me, then a short word

text.en:
You can say him, her, me, us or them.
I saw him drop the key.
She watched me sign the receipt.
Want to say it was going on?
Add ing.
I saw the driver getting out.

You will say what you saw, heard or felt.
And more.
She watched me sign the receipt.
We watched the paint dripping.
Let means allow.
They let me use the printer.
